''' Related NPCs: ''' | [[Radiant]], [[a shadowed man]], [[Tarn Visilin]] , [[Tizina]], [[a dusty werebat]], [[a silvered guard]], [[Ezmirella]], [[Raine Beteria]], [[A Froglok Scryer]], [[Enynti]], [[Mizr N`Mar]], [[Madame Serena]] |} == Rewards == {{Gear Set |Incandescent Mask |Incandescent Gloves |Incandescent Wand }} == Walkthrough == [[File:npc_sultin.png|thumb|right|Sultin]] Incandescent gear is Enchanter specific quested items from The Temple of Solusek Ro. Talk to Sultin. '''You say, 'Hail, Sultin'''' : Sultin says, 'I am Sultin - keeper of the three [incandescent]s of power and the [rod] of Insidious Glamour. If you are an enchanter, perhaps we can deal.' '''You say, 'incandescent'''' : Sultin says, 'There are three incandescent items of power - a [wand], [mask] and [gloves]. Are you [interested] in any of them?' === Incandescent Gloves === Obtain the following for [[Sultin]]:{{CheckboxList}} * [[Glowing Gloves]] from [[a shadowed man]] * [[Radiant Gloves]] from [[Radiant]] in [[Cazic Thule|The Temple of Cazic-Thule]] * [[Enchanted Gloves]] by giving 5 pp to [[Tizina]] in [[Lavastorm Mountains]] * [[Gleaming Gloves]] by giving a [[bloodstone]] to [[Tarn Visilin]] in [[Highpass Keep]] {{End}} '''You say, 'I am interested in the gloves'''' : Sultin says, 'My personal favorite! Incandescent gloves. If you bring me the components to make another pair, I will give you my gloves. Incandescent gloves are made by sewing together four other sets of gloves. Glowing gloves can be found on our mortal enemies, the shadowed men. Radiant gloves can be found on Radiant in the mazes of Cazic-Thule. Enchanted and gleaming gloves can be purchased for 50 golden coins from Tizina of the Lavastorm gypsies and a bloodstone from Tarn Vislin of High Keep. Bring me all four sets of gloves and I will give you a pair of incandescent ones.' [[a shadowed man|Shadowed men]] can be found in many zones. [[Glowing Gloves]] drom randomly from any of them. Kill [[Radiant]] in [[Cazic Thule|The Temple of Cazic-Thule]] and loot the [[Radiant Gloves]]. Go to [[Lavastorm Mountains]] and give 5 platinum pieces to [[Tizina]], and she gives you the [[Enchanted Gloves]]: : Tizina says, 'Since you have given me gold, I will give you gloves. For more magic gloves, give a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in the High Keep library.' In [[Highpass Keep]], get the [[Gleaming Gloves]] by giving a [[bloodstone]] to [[Tarn Visilin]]: : Tarn Visilin says, 'The gleam of blood - and now the gleam of gloves.' Take all 4 gloves back to [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]] and give them to [[Sultin]]:
* Your faction with [[Temple of Solusek Ro]] got better. * Your faction with [[Shadowed Men]] got worse.
=== Incandescent Mask === Sultin needs four items:{{CheckboxList}} * [[Glowing Mask]], found on [[a froglok scryer]] or [[a skeleton monk]] in [[Upper Guk]] * [[Rune of Fortune]] (top), from [[Enynti]] in the Chasm below [[Mistmoore]] * [[Rune of Fortune]] (bottom) by giving 5 pp to [[Mizr N`Mar]] in the [[Neriak|Neriak City Library]] * [[Rune of Fortune]] (middle) by giving 5 pp to [[Madame Serena]] in [[Qeynos|South Qeynos]] {{End}} '''You say, 'I am interested in the mask'''' : Sultin says, 'An item of power! The incandescent mask. If you will bring me the components to make another, I will give you my own incandescent mask. I will need a glowing mask, found on the skeletal monk in the caverns of Guk. I will also need all three runes of fortune. One rune can be found on the dark elf Enynti in the chasm below Castle Mistmoore. The other two can be purchased for 50 golden coins, one from Mizr N'Mar in the Neriak City Library and the other from Madam Serena in the city of Qeynos. Bring me all three runes and the glowing mask and I will give you your reward.' Kill [[a froglok scryer]] or [[a skeleton monk]] in [[Upper Guk]] for the [[Glowing Mask]]. Kill the Dark Elf [[Enynti]] in the Chasm below [[Mistmoore]] for the [[Rune of Fortune]] (top). Hand 5 platinum pieces to [[Mizr N`Mar]] in the [[Neriak|Neriak City Library]]: : Mizr N`Mar says, 'Ahhh - gold. Here is the rune you desire.' Mizr N`Mar gives you the [[Rune of Fortune]] (bottom). In [[Qeynos|South Qeynos]], behind the Mermaid's Lure near the dock, hand 5 platinum pieces to [[Madame Serena]]: : Madame Serena give you the [[Rune of Fortune]] (middle).
* Your faction with [[Temple of Solusek Ro]] got better. * Your faction with [[Shadowed Men]] got worse.
=== Incandescent Wand === Sultin needs:{{CheckboxList}} * [[Pouch of Silver Dust]] from the [[a dusty werebat]] in [[The Estate of Unrest]] * [[Glowing Silver Wand]] from [[Raine Beteria]] ** [[Blessed Silver Wand]] from [[Ezmirella]] (and 5 pp) *** [[Silver Wand]] from [[a silvered guard]] in [[Cazic Thule (Zone)|The Temple of Cazic-Thule]] (and 5 pp) {{End}} '''You say, 'I am interested in the wand'''' : Sultin says, 'Ahh, the incandescent wand. If you will get the components to make another, I will give you mine. I will need a pouch of silver dust, found on the dusty werebat in the Estate of Unrest. I will also need a silver wand, found on a silvered guard in the temple of Cazic-Thule. This wand will not be enchanted - you will need to pay Esmirella of the North Karana gypsy camp 50 gold to enchant it for you. When the wand is fully enchanted, bring it and the pouch to me and I will give you the incandescent wand.' In [[The Estate of Unrest]], get the keys and go to the basement. Slay a [[A Dusty Werebat|a dusty werebat]] to get the [[Pouch of Silver Dust]]. In [[Cazic Thule (Zone)|The Temple of Cazic-Thule]], find [[a silvered guard]] at the northwest pyramids, and kill it to get a [[Silver Wand]]. Find [[Ezmirella]] in the gypsy camp in the [[Northern Plains of Karana]]. Hand her the [[Silver Wand]] and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum). She will return a [[Blessed Silver Wand]] and instruct you to seek out [[Raine Beteria]]. : Ezmirella says, 'I have blessed your silver wand. To complete the enchantment, you must take the wand to Raine Beteria in the Erudin library. Tip her 50 golden coins, and she will help you.' Hand Raine the [[Blessed Silver Wand]] and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum) to receive the [[Glowing Silver Wand]]. : Raine Beteria says, 'Your silver wand has been fully enchanted. Take it and the pouch of silver dust back to the temple of Ro.' Take the [[Glowing Silver Wand]] and [[Pouch of Silver Dust]] back to Sultin. Hand him both. : Sultin says, 'I see that you are resourceful... you have earned your incandescent wand.' {{exp}}
* Your faction standing with [[Temple of Solusek Ro]] has been adjusted by 5. * Your faction standing with [[Shadowed Men]] has been adjusted by -1.
You receive the [[Incandescent Wand]]. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Temple of Solusek Ro]] [[Category:Enchanter Quests]]
